import subprocess, sys

# Install the package first
subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'setup.py', 'develop'], capture_output=True, text=True)

# Test bare pysemver
result = subprocess.run(['pysemver'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(f"bare pysemver: exit={result.returncode}, stderr={result.stderr[:200]!r}")

# Test pysemver bump without specific args
result = subprocess.run(['pysemver', 'bump'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(f"pysemver bump: exit={result.returncode}, stdout={result.stdout[:200]!r}")
